content:
Earlier this year, we learned that Volvo plans to support features such as Apple Music's spatial audio through a CarPlay update. Today, Volvo has once again confirmed that it will provide this support and announced the details of this audio upgrade.

In January this year, Volvo pledged to continue supporting Apple CarPlay, even as some automakers like GM reduced support in certain models. At that time, we also mentioned that the Volvo EX60 SUV would support spatial audio via CarPlay.

Volvo today announced more details about the spatial audio feature, particularly for the EX90:

The latest software update also brings spatial audio with Dolby Atmos support to CarPlay* in the Volvo EX90. Combined with the Bowers & Wilkins premium sound system, which includes 25 high-performance speakers, Volvo drivers can enjoy a multi-dimensional, immersive audio experience that surrounds music and vocals throughout the cabin.

Volvo added: "The spatial audio feature in CarPlay requires the Bowers & Wilkins sound system to deliver the full immersive experience, available as an option when purchasing the Volvo EX60, EX90, and ES90."

Not in the market for a new car? Earlier this year, Pioneer launched the first aftermarket CarPlay system that supports Dolby Atmos spatial audio playback.
